prose: A few years back, Jim Maiden and S.B. Alger hosted a weekly livestream: RX Only Picture Show. In this episode, we're going to look at their journey as multi-skilled independent artists and obsessively spiritual conspiracy researchers, from the days before RXOP to 2022, where you can catch Jim, SB, and many others (me included) on Wednesdays and Saturday streaming our syncretic live streams-of-consciousness to the Weaving Spiders Welcome YouTube channel.
